faq.a: Jamillah is associated with the Arabic form جميلة, whose core sense is beautiful, comely (feminine).

faq.q: What is the origin of Jamillah?
faq.a: Jamillah is associated with Arabic. Jamillah is Arabic جَمِيلَة (Jamīla) 'beautiful, comely' (feminine), from the root ج م ل (j-m-l). The source gloss 'Beautiful, lovely, gracious' is broadly consistent. Same name as jameela, jameelah, jamilaa and jamilah.
Yes — the underlying form جميلة is Arabic.
Jamillah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Jamillah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. False

faq.q: What does Jamillah mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Jamillah is rendered جمیلہ and carries the sense جمیلہ، خوبصورت.

faq.q: What does Jamillah mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Jamillah is rendered جمیله and carries the sense جمیله، زیبا.
A romanized syllable approximation is ja-mil-lah. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Jamillah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Jamillah, jamillah. Script forms are جميلة, جمیله, جمیلہ, जमीला.

faq.q: Is Jamillah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
